title: Bibliothèques Virtuelles Humanistes: Epistemon (printed texts)
notes: Transcriptions of Renaissance printed texts from the Epistemon corpus of the Bibliothèques Virtuelles Humanistes (CESR, Université de Tours). The entry links to the corpus on the BVH site; the TEI files used for the corpus statistics come from a legacy copy kept in Lou Burnard's tei-fr repository on GitHub (last updated 2015). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).

institution: Centre d'études supérieures de la Renaissance (CESR), Université de Tours / CNRS (Bibliothèques Virtuelles Humanistes)
